content.text:
Finding submitted: **deviation** on § 12.4 (p0045).

- **Issue:** One-way no-hire binding only us, 24 months, covering *any* Vendor employee "regardless of how the employee applies" — no general-advertising or unsolicited-approach carve-out. No-hire language and all-personnel scope are walk-away items; duration and one-sidedness also fail the fallback. It further conflicts with § 12.3, which states we made no no-hire commitment.
- **Redline (validated ok:true):** replaced with a mutual 12-month non-solicit limited to personnel directly involved in the Services, with general-advertising/unsolicited-approach carve-outs and an express no-hire disclaimer.
